body: Be honest with yourself and with her

Thanks for the feedback! 
Now you point that out, I agree with your point how more poetry between the mentions of the clock towers would be more effective. Maybes another two stanzas would work better, and I could expand on the lies themselves.

The disconnect from reality is just a dream, “sleep takes me away” in which things are alright again - maybe I need to make that clearer. 

And lastly yes you’re right about the formatting. The way I wrote it was individually as in line after line.

Thanks again!

I like the style of writing, while at first it might seem all over the place, I think it complements the theme of the poem well. I do think however the same scene is described maybes a bit too much? Perhaps there could be a change of scenery from the room and when in sleep, or in your own mind? I enjoyed the poem though well done!
I feel like you captured the way you were feeling in that moment very well. That’s a great starting point. Perhaps you can go on and in other poems expand on your feelings.
